comment: Furiah's Visuals: Frostbrand's own clips (its swings, guard and draw are the saber set's). right: the fist in view space (offset in blocks, turns in degrees about the fist: pitch up, yaw left, roll counter-clockwise), or an exact place and direction ({pos, tip, edge}). flare: the cold mist rolling off (more of it). reveal: how far up the blade its edges are (Ice finish: past it they are gone; 1: whole). Every clip here is original to this mod.

frostbrand_frost_breath.comment: Frost breath: the blade brought up side on; mist rolls off it, its edges melt away from the tip down, then the ice grows back along them from the guard to the tip, a frosty glint running ahead.
